meta.label: before-fix-2026-09-23
meta.cacheDriftPreFixObservation: Manually observed 2026-09-23, before this fix: two captures of the IDENTICAL production inv=1 URL (no order= param) returned DIFFERENT membership counts — 134 places without Ryans Coffee House vs 152 places WITH it — while BOTH responses carried x-vercel-cache: HIT. This is the nondeterministic capped/unordered read being cached at the CDN edge for ~24h: which arbitrary heap-order slice got cached (and then served as a HIT to every request since) was itself a coin flip at cache-fill time. Post-fix (ordered, exhaustive reads), --checkCacheDrift on this script re-fetches page 0 of every pair a second time after a delay and flags any membership difference as cache_drift -- this becomes a plain regression check that should find zero drift going forward.
